decisions.summary: Preserve existing commitments and prepare version-bound pending review requests.
decisions.concern: How should proposal dates, unknown facts and reviewer authority be represented?
options: Replace elapsed dates with invented deadlines
Preserve recorded proposals and request explicit review
decisions.chosen_behavior: Retain all eight actions with source status and dates; add one undated factual clarification; mark every draft approval pending.
decisions.rationale: The calendar supplies commitments, while policy reserves activation, date confirmation, exceptions and closure to humans.
tradeoffs: Historical dates can look overdue at retrieval; explicitly separate August review from October access and avoid unapproved rescheduling.
decisions.downstream_effect: Eight tentative all-day events; one undated action omitted with explanation. Requests remain unsent and bind exact final draft hashes.
